market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades near $33, requiring an unprecedented ~3.6x rally to $120 in just ~14 months. Even during the most extreme historical silver rallies (e.g., 2010-2011, 1979-1980), the maximum percentage gain over such a period was far less. The target is so far out of range that the true probability is a fraction of a percent, while the market implies 6.7%. This gives a massive edge to 'No'.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time high is ~$50 (1980, 2011), making $120 a >2x increase above any historical peak.
A sustained 260%+ rally within 14 months has no precedent in silver's modern trading history.
CME settlement rules ensure only official end-of-day prices count, eliminating anomalous intraday spikes.
